# GeomPrototypeAPI

Native-instancing tag that [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population writes on native-instancing prototype prims. The parser reads no column for it; prototype prims provide the geometry and attributes that instance proxies resolve to.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable), [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable), [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by ovstage population; no [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema applies it.

## Notes

- No USD schema applies this name and it declares no column; the parser keys native instancing on the ovstage instancing queries (instance and prototype roots), not on attributes.
